args: Which specific products drive discrepancies at the three standout apparel sites

At Atlanta (Cragsley Outfitters), Reading (Marrowby & Vane) and Den Haag (Studio Vrij) — the three sites with by far the most stock-count discrepancies — is the problem spread across the catalog, or concentrated in a handful of specific products/size-color variants?
